faqs.question: What type of vehicle do you use for pet transportation?
faqs.answer: A private SUV with sanitised mats and room for up to 3 dogs. The air conditioning is on before every pickup. You can ride along.

faqs.question: How many pets can travel in the car?
faqs.answer: Our vehicle can accommodate up to 3 large dogs or 4 medium-sized dogs, depending on their size and how much space they need.

faqs.question: Is the vehicle air-conditioned?
faqs.answer: Yes, the air conditioning stays on throughout the journey to keep pets cool and calm in Bali's tropical climate.

faqs.question: Can pet owners travel with their pets?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Up to 2 people can ride along with their pet at no extra cost.

faqs.question: Do you provide pet transportation outside Bali?
faqs.answer: At the moment, our transportation service covers Bali island only.

faqs.question: What if my destination is outside your listed service zones but still within Bali?
faqs.answer: No problem! Contact us for a personalized quote.

faqs.question: Do I need to book in advance?
faqs.answer: Advance booking is highly recommended to secure your preferred date and time.

faqs.question: Do you accept same-day bookings?
faqs.answer: Yes, same-day bookings are welcome, subject to availability.

faqs.question: Do you provide round-trip service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both one-way and round-trip services are available.

faqs.question: Is there any additional fee if I need the driver to wait?
faqs.answer: Yes. On a round trip the driver waits on site and the fare is twice the one-way price.

faqs.question: Will my pet travel with other pets?
faqs.answer: No. The PawCab provides private transportation.

faqs.question: Do you provide a pet crate?
faqs.answer: Yes, a medium-sized pet crate is available upon request.

faqs.question: Can you transport my pet without me?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Your pet can travel with us without you.

faqs.question: Can I request walking times?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend early morning (07:00 - 09:00) or late afternoon (16:30 - 18:30) to avoid hot pavement and the midday heat.

faqs.question: What if my dog is reactive to other dogs?
faqs.answer: Our walks are private and handlers are trained to manage space, choose quiet paths, and keep a safe distance from street dogs.

faqs.question: How many dogs can join each walking session?
faqs.answer: Each session accommodates up to 2 dogs to ensure personalized attention and a comfortable experience.

faqs.question: How long is each walking session?
faqs.answer: Our standard walking session lasts one hour.

faqs.question: Will my dog be walked with other dogs?
faqs.answer: No, every walk is private: just your dog and the handler.

faqs.question: Do I need to be home during the walk?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily! We can walk your dog without you being present, as long as pickup and access arrangements have been confirmed in advance.

faqs.question: Is transportation included in the walking fee?
faqs.answer: Transportation is not required for neighborhood walks. For beach walks, an additional pet transportation fee applies based on your location.

faqs.question: Can I choose which beach my dog visits?
faqs.answer: Of course! You can request your preferred beach, or we can recommend a suitable beach near your location.

faqs.question: Do you provide same-day booking?
faqs.answer: Yes! Same-day bookings are welcome, subject to availability. However, advance booking is recommended.

faqs.question: What happens if it rains?
faqs.answer: If weather conditions are unsuitable, we'll discuss rescheduling the walk to keep your dog safe and comfortable.

faqs.question: Will my dog be allowed off-leash?
faqs.answer: For safety, dogs are kept on a leash during walks unless a safe, permitted area and suitable arrangements have been confirmed in advance.

faqs.question: Can I add basic obedience training to my pet's session?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Basic obedience exercises can be added to your Pet Walking or Pet Sitting session upon request.

faqs.question: What will my dog learn?
faqs.answer: We focus on essential commands such as Sit, Down, Stay, Come, and basic leash manners, depending on your dog's needs.

faqs.question: Is this a professional dog training program?
faqs.answer: No. This is a light obedience reinforcement service designed to encourage good habits during your pet's regular activities.

faqs.question: Is there an additional charge?
faqs.answer: Yes, Basic Obedience is available as an optional add-on.

faqs.question: Can my dog learn everything in one session?
faqs.answer: Every dog learns at a different pace. Consistent practice and reinforcement at home are important for long-term progress.

faqs.question: Do you do a meet-and-greet beforehand?
faqs.answer: Yes, we always arrange a complimentary meet-and-greet so your pets become familiar with their sitter and we can learn their routines.

faqs.question: Can you administer oral medication?
faqs.answer: Yes, our sitters are experienced in administering oral medications and supplements according to your vet's instructions.

faqs.question: Where does the pet sitting take place?
faqs.answer: We provide in-home pet sitting at your house, villa, or accommodation, so your pets can stay comfortable in a familiar environment.

faqs.question: Do you offer overnight pet sitting?
faqs.answer: Overnight sitting may be arranged upon request, subject to availability and confirmation.

faqs.question: How long can I book a pet sitter?
faqs.answer: Sitting arrangements can be tailored to your needs. Let us know your preferred dates and duration, and we'll help you find the most suitable option.

faqs.question: What does your Pet Sitting service include?
faqs.answer: Our service focuses on companionship, supervision, feeding, fresh water, and basic daily care based on your pet's usual routine.

faqs.question: Can you follow my pet's feeding schedule?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We aim to follow your pet's regular feeding schedule and care instructions to keep their routine consistent.

faqs.question: Will my pet receive individual attention?
faqs.answer: Yes! We focus on personalized care, ensuring your pet receives companionship and care suited to their individual needs.

faqs.question: Will I receive updates about my pet?
faqs.answer: Updates and photos can be arranged during the sitting session, so you can stay connected while you're away.

faqs.question: How much does pet sitting cost?
faqs.answer: Our rates depend on your location, the number of pets, and the duration of care.

faqs.question: Can you take my pet for a walk during the sitting session?
faqs.answer: Dog walking can be arranged upon request. Additional charges may apply depending on the walking arrangements.

faqs.question: What information should I provide before booking?
faqs.answer: Please share your location, preferred schedule, number of pets, feeding routine, temperament, and any special care requirements.

spotlightStory.title: Luna's First Sunset Run at Echo Beach
spotlightStory.quote: PawCab completely changed how we explore Bali. Luna hopped in without any hesitation!
spotlightStory.story: Before discovering PawCab, getting Luna into any regular car was a stressful ordeal. She would pace, pant, and refuse to enter. PawCab provided a flat, clean floor mat, gentle air conditioning, and a driver who understood pets. By the time we arrived at Echo Beach, Luna was relaxed, happy, and energized for an unforgettable sunset run.

storiesList.title: Luna's First Sunset Run at Echo Beach
storiesList.imageAlt: Two happy dogs running freely on open grass in the sunshine
storiesList.excerpt: Luna used to get car-sick on normal rides. With PawCab's spacious cabin and gentle driving, she had the calmest ride of her life.

storiesList.title: Milo & Koko: Moving to Their New Villa in Ubud
storiesList.imageAlt: Cute calm cat looking comfortably through soft light
storiesList.excerpt: Relocating two rescue cats across Bali can be noisy and nerve-wracking. PawCab provided a quiet, crate-secure environment.
storiesList.fullStory: Cats are sensitive to motion and loud noises. When moving our villa from Seminyak up to Ubud, we were dreading the two-hour transit. PawCab arrived on time, secured the carriers safely, and took the scenic roads with minimal stops.
storiesList.quote: Door-to-door, prompt arrival, and zero complaints from our two cats the whole trip.

storiesList.title: Rocky's Post-Surgery Comfort Ride
storiesList.imageAlt: Golden dog resting peacefully wrapped in blanket
storiesList.excerpt: Transporting a 35kg dog after orthopedic surgery required utmost gentleness. PawCab's handler helped lift him with a stretcher mat.
storiesList.fullStory: Rocky underwent knee surgery at Sunset Vet and could not put weight on his back leg. The PawCab driver brought a specialized lifting harness and drove at a steady pace to avoid any jolts.
storiesList.quote: The gentle handling made all the difference during a very anxious morning.
